required_outcomes.statement: Async filesystem append/read persists newline-delimited JSON in a caller-selected local file; historical synchronous-only claims are obsolete.
An event id must be a string; amount is not validated. Corrupt JSON propagates read failure rather than self-repair.

Cloud replication is planned, while HTTP endpoints, authentication and remote replication are absent.
